Item # 465530 Relieve flu-like symptoms naturally with Boiron Oscillococcinum, a homeopathic medicine trusted by millions. This non-drowsy and easy-to-take remedy is specifically formulated to alleviate body aches, fever, chills, and fatigue associated with the flu. Oscillococcinum works by stimulating the body's natural defense mechanisms to help reduce the duration and severity of flu symptoms. Its pellet form melts quickly under the tongue for convenient use. Boiron Oscillococcinum is suitable for adults and children ages 2 and up, providing relief without the side effects of traditional medications. Take control of your flu symptoms with Boiron Oscillococcinum and get back to feeling like yourself again. Always read and follow the label instructions. HSA/FSA Eligible. Alleviates body aches, fever, chills, and fatigue. Stimulates natural defense mechanisms. Non-drowsy formula. Convenient pellet form. Suitable for adults and children. Rating & reviews Ingredients See the full list of product ingredients on the product label. Active Ingredients Active Ingredients: Anas barbariae 200CK HPUS. Inactive Ingredients Inactive Ingredients: Lactose, Sucrose. Directions Directions: Adults and children 2 years of age and older: Dissolve entire contents of one tube in the mouth every 6 hours, up to 3 times a day. Children younger than 2 years of age: Ask a doctor. Warnings Ask a doctor before use in children under 2 years of age. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist for more than 3 days or worsen. If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children.
